services.name: AFTERNOON SAILING & SNORKELING TOUR
services.desc: AFTERNOON SAILING & SNORKELING TOUR After sailing down the beautiful Kona Coast on our spacious 50 foot catamaran, your snorkeling adventure will begin in the pristine waters and the vibrant reef of the Marine Sanctuary of Kealakekua Bay. "Hawaii the Big Island Revealed" guide book says, "snorkeling in Kealakekua Bay near the monument is perhaps the best you will find anywhere in the state." PRICES Adult - $125 Per person Children (4-12) – $75 per person Toddler (3 and under) – $45 per person ITINERARY The Hoku Nui sets sail from Keauhou Bay at 2 pm. Keep a watchful eye out for Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins, Hawaiian Humpback Whales (seasonal Dec-April), and other marine life while you sail

blurb: Sea Paradise Hawaii has operated snorkel and manta ray tours from Keauhou Bay on the Kona Coast of Hawaii’s Big Island since 1985, making it one of the original and longest-running ocean tour companies in Kona. Every tour departs aboard the Hoku Nui - a 50-foot luxury sailing catamaran designed for a spacious and comfortable experience for up to 49 guests - sailing to Kealakekua Bay (day snorkel tours) or Manta
